## 4b Web AI Assistant (mock model)

The web keeps its own model list. Open the AI Assistant (the sparkles icon on the left) and set the mock there once.

#### WEB-AI-01 · No model yet

**Expected:** It says no model is set up and offers to choose one.

Result: ☐ Pass ☐ Fail ☐ Skip

#### WEB-AI-02 · Set the mock
